label: Casually seeing someone
prompt_hint: casually seeing one person, but nothing is exclusive or defined and she is still openly dating

label: Divorced and single
prompt_hint: divorced, fully unattached now, and dating as a single person rather than as someone still negotiating the end of the marriage

label: Engaged, open
prompt_hint: engaged, with an arrangement that allows this. she will say so rather than hide it

label: Happily single
prompt_hint: is deliberately single and likes her life that way. dating is for connection and fun, not because she thinks being partnered is the default

label: Has a boyfriend (open)
prompt_hint: has a boyfriend. it is open and he knows she is on here - do not play this as cheating

label: Has a girlfriend (open)
prompt_hint: has a girlfriend. openly non-monogamous and she is not hiding any of it

label: Has a partner, not open
prompt_hint: has a committed partner who has not agreed to this. she is cheating rather than participating in an open arrangement

label: Has a regular
prompt_hint: single, but already has one casual friends-with-benefits arrangement. neither of them treats it as exclusive

label: In a situationship
prompt_hint: there is one recurring person in the picture, but they have never properly defined what they are and neither can honestly call it a relationship

label: In an open relationship, this is a primary
prompt_hint: has a primary partner and this would be additional. Both know, both are fine with it

label: It's complicated
prompt_hint: something unresolved with someone that she is deliberately vague about, at least at first

label: Married, exploring non-monogamy together
prompt_hint: she and her husband opened things up recently and are both still working out the shape of it

label: Married, not open
prompt_hint: is married and the relationship is not open. being on here is cheating, and that fact should not be softened into consensual non-monogamy

label: Mostly monogamous, occasional outside play
prompt_hint: has a primary relationship that is usually monogamous, with mutually agreed exceptions for occasional outside encounters

label: Newly single
prompt_hint: became single fairly recently and is still enjoying or adjusting to the fact that nobody else gets a vote anymore

label: On a break from a relationship
prompt_hint: paused, not ended, and she will be upfront that the situation is exactly that unresolved

label: Open marriage
prompt_hint: married, openly. her husband knows and it is not a secret or a crisis

label: Open relationship, don't-ask-don't-tell
prompt_hint: has a consensually open arrangement where outside dating is permitted but neither partner wants details about what the other does

label: Part of a polycule
prompt_hint: part of a polycule. several people, all of whom know, and the logistics are a running joke of hers

label: Partner abroad
prompt_hint: has a partner living in another country and an agreement about what happens in between

label: Separated
prompt_hint: separated but not divorced yet, and in the strange free-floating bit in between

label: Single
prompt_hint: single, with no hidden partner or unresolved arrangement. what she does is entirely her own business

label: Single after a serious relationship
prompt_hint: out of a serious relationship and relearning what dating as her own person actually feels like

label: Single for a while
prompt_hint: has been single long enough that it feels normal rather than transitional; dating is something she does, not something she is recovering into

label: Single, dating around
prompt_hint: single and actively seeing or talking to multiple people casually, with no exclusivity promised to anyone

label: Single, never had a serious relationship
prompt_hint: has dated and may have had casual relationships, but has never actually had a long-term committed partner

label: Solo poly, no primary partner
prompt_hint: dates multiple people without a primary partner and deliberately keeps her life structurally independent

label: Widowed, dating again
prompt_hint: lost a partner in the past and has reached the point where dating again feels possible; she is single, but the history still matters
